label: D785 IP phone
description: Snom D785 Linux-based desk phone with a dual display (main colour plus SmartDisplay labels), 12 SIP identities and two Gigabit RJ45 sockets labelled NET and PC. PoE IEEE 802.3af class 3, or the optional 5 V adapter.
notes: Snom documentation: '2 x RJ45-8P8C (NET/PC) sockets', 'Power over Ethernet (PoE): IEEE 802.3af class 2/3', with the footnote that the Bluetooth-less D785N is class 2 while the D785 with Bluetooth is class 3 - hence 12.95 W here. The NET port is the uplink and PC is a daisy-chain passthrough (explicitly for chaining further Ethernet devices). Bluetooth 4.0 class 2 for headsets. USB 2.0 Type A, EHS RJ12 and headset RJ9 are not modelled.
